caption: The drawing is composed of two main sections on a vertically oriented sheet. At the top, there is a simple pencil sketch of a jar with two small handles near the top on either side. The jar has text inscribed on it which reads “E. & L. P. NORTON / BENNINGTON VT. / 2.” Below the text, there is a decorative flourish drawn in pencil, consisting of curved lines and small circular elements. In the lower section of the drawing, set within a grayscale rectangular background, there is a bold blue design created with flowing, curvilinear strokes and dots. This design features a central floral motif, with a stylized blossom and petal shapes extending outward, accompanied by sweeping, curling lines and several dot accents. The overall composition contrasts the lighter pencil drawing on the upper portion with the vivid blue ink or paint in the lower decorative section. The paper itself shows slight discoloration and some small brownish spots, particularly in the corners and edges. The artist's name "Yolande Delasser" is lightly inscribed near the lower right corner.
title: Jar
